BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled in the heart of Roundwood village, this brand new A-rated home offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy modern living in one of Wicklow’s most picturesque settings.
Designed with energy efficiency, comfort and quality in mind, the development offers a lifestyle change within the tranquillity of the Wicklow countryside.
This home features bright and spacious interiors, with well-proportioned living spaces designed for today’s modern lifestyles. The home is finished to a high standard with contemporary kitchens, energy-efficient air-to-water heat pump systems, and excellent insulation to achieve a superb A2 BER rating.
Externally, the home benefits from landscaped front gardens, and secure rear gardens offering privacy and space.
________________________________________
LOCATION
Situated in the heart of Roundwood village, this development enjoys the charm of country living with the convenience of having local amenities right on your doorstep. Roundwood offers a welcoming community with shops, cafés, a post office, traditional pubs, a primary school, and easy access to a range of outdoor pursuits including nearby Vartry Reservoir walks, Wicklow Way trails, and Glendalough National Park.
Roundwood’s central location in the Wicklow Mountains offers convenient access to nearby towns such as Wicklow, Ashford, Kilcoole, Greystones, and Bray, while Dublin is easily commutable via the N11/M11 motorway network.

________________________________________
KEY FEATURES
• A2 BER Rated Energy-Efficient Homes
• Air-to-water heat pump
• Landscaped private rear gardens
• Contemporary kitchens and bathrooms
• High-quality finishes throughout
• Located in a peaceful setting within walking distance of Roundwood village
• A short drive to Glendalough, Laragh and the Wicklow Mountains National Park
• Easy commuting distance to Dublin via the N11/M11
________________________________________
VIEWING
Call us today to arrange a viewing of these superb new homes in Roundwood.
